title: Flat comparison of filtered cochain complexes
statement: Let $A\to B$ be a flat homomorphism of commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. Let $(C^\bullet,F)$ be a bounded-below cochain complex of $A$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] with a finite, exhaustive decreasing filtration by subcomplexes [def-sp-filtration], and let $(D^\bullet,F)$ be such a filtered complex of $B$-modules. Suppose $u:C^\bullet\otimes_A B\to D^\bullet$ is a filtered cochain map. For the convergent spectral sequences [thm-sp-spectral-object-yields] of these filtrations, flatness canonically identifies every page $E_r(C\otimes_A B)$ with $E_r(C)\otimes_A B$, compatibly with differentials. If the induced map $E_2^{p,q}(C)\otimes_A B\to E_2^{p,q}(D)$ is an isomorphism for every $(p,q)$, then $H^n(u):H^n(C)\otimes_A B\to H^n(D)$ is an isomorphism for every $n$.

proof.text: The canonical flat homology comparison is natural in maps of quotient complexes. Combine it with g and use the quotient-projection equations to obtain a commuting square for the two model quotient maps. Preservation of images gives the page object isomorphisms e0, with the required image-inclusion equation.

proof.text: Cycle representatives cover the source page epimorphically. Transport their cycle, differential and target-cycle lifts using s, g, and the canonical flat comparison on cycles. A map satisfying the representative equations factors through the prescribed representative subobject, so the target model differential equation holds for it. Cancel the representative epimorphism and the target image monomorphism. Thus e0 commutes with each differential and assembles to e as an isomorphism of page complexes.
